name: pwa-prefeitura
description: Piloto de PWA de atendimento ao cidadao (React + Vite + vite-plugin-pwa + Express)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
